content:
Apple yesterday released iOS 27 beta 5, which in addition to new app icons and minor Spotlight design adjustments, also includes code for all new iPhone models expected to launch in the next six to eight months.

Unannounced iPhone codes

According to Macworld, which first spotted it, iOS 27 beta 5 contains code for six unannounced iPhones, covering the entire iPhone 18 lineup, the iPhone Air 2, and the upcoming foldable iPhone Ultra. These codes were found in 'system files related to the iPhone battery driver and battery intelligence features.'

These codes only contain Apple's internal identifiers (such as V62, V63, etc.) and do not list marketing names. However, based on other leaks, these model identifiers can be mapped to the expected marketing names:

  • V62: iPhone Air 2
  • V63: iPhone 18 Pro
  • V64: iPhone 18 Pro Max
  • V67: iPhone 18
  • V68: iPhone Ultra (or iPhone Fold)
  • V69: iPhone 18e

This update does not provide further information about these devices. Apple is expected to kick off the iPhone 18 cycle next month with the unveiling of the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. The iPhone Ultra is also expected to be announced next month.

According to reports, the iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, and iPhone Air 2 will launch at some point in early 2027. This marks the first time Apple has adjusted the iPhone release schedule, splitting its annual launch events into two windows.

Which new iPhone model are you most looking forward to Apple releasing? Are you interested in the iPhone Ultra? Let us know in the comments.
